university: Asia Pacific University of Technology & Innovation
program_name: Diploma in Information & Communication Technology with a specialism in Data Informatics

fees.notes: APU official course page: total international tuition RM54,200 (excludes 6% SST). Source: https://www.apu.edu.my/course/diploma-in-ict-data-informatics (accessed 2026-09-18).

requirements.english_requirement: IELTS : 4.5 / TOEFL IBT : 2 / Pearson (PTE) : 43 / MUET : Band 3
requirements.general: General Requirements SPM 3 Credits in at least 3 subjects at SPM level including Mathematics#, with a minimum of a pass in Bahasa Malaysia and Sejarah (History); IGCSE/O-LEVELS 3 Credits (Grade C & above) in at least 3 subjects at IGCSE/O-LEVELS including Mathematics#; UEC 3 Credits (Grade B & above) in at least 3 subjects in UEC including Mathematics#; CERTIFICATE Pass relevant Certificate Programme or its equivalent; # Candidates with only a Pass in Maths in SPM/IGCSE/O-Levels or equivalent will be required to complete and pass “Mathematics and Statistics for Computing” in their Semester 1 of Diploma A qualification that APU accepts as equivalent to the above. Note: The above entry requirements may differ for specific programmes based on the latest programme standards published by Malaysian Qualifications Agency (MQA). The qualification and entry requirements for the programmes will be determined based on the " Comparison List of Equivalency of International Qualifications with SPM (O-Levels equivalent) and STPM (A-Levels equivalent) " published by Malaysian Qualifications Agency (MQA).

program_name_ar: دبلوم Information & Communication Technology with a specialism in Data Informatics
program_name_zh: 信息与通信技术文凭（数据信息学专业）
description: يهدف برنامج تكنولوجيا المعلومات والاتصالات في معلوماتية البيانات إلى تزويد الطالب بمعرفة أكاديمية ومهارات عملية متخصصة في المجال، مع ربط المفاهيم النظرية بالتطبيقات الحديثة وسوق العمل. يساعد البرنامج الطالب على تطوير التفكير التحليلي وحل المشكلات والعمل على المشاريع التطبيقية، ويؤهله للانطلاق المهني أو متابعة الدراسات العليا في تخصص قريب.
